caption: Fig. 1.7: The vapour pressure curve for solution lies below the curve for pure water. The diagram shows that ΔT_b denotes the elevation of boiling point of a solvent in solution.
note: "Boiling point of" is printed above the pair of arrow labels "Solvent" and "Solution", which point to the two curve intersections with the 1.013 bar line. "Solvent" and "Solution" also appear a second time printed along the orange and blue curves respectively. Subscripts b are printed as subscripts; T_b^0 carries a superscript 0. The y-axis label "Vapour pressure" and the x-axis label "Temperature/K" each end with a printed arrow.
